assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept. Create a production illustration-only asset for the Everkeep NFT marketplace, using the attached card mockup as the EDIT TARGET and reference for the character and environment. Rebuild ONLY the illustration: the fictional green frog CEO in a luxurious black tailored suit, oversized translucent chartreuse glasses, relaxed executive pose in a leather chair, holding a tiny rocket-shaped cigar with an elegant wisp of smoke, futuristic space-office window with the Moon behind him, dark graphite and deep green environment with lime rim lighting, small chrome bull desk sculpture and floating espresso cup. Keep the frog's recognizable face, self-assured expression, rich materials and polished cinematic 3D render. Recompose the art to a landscape 4:3 composition, close portrait readable at thumbnail sizes: frog face near the central upper half, body and hand within the frame, moon behind to the upper right, room context around. Full bleed rectangular art, opaque background. Absolutely NO lettering, words, numbers, brand marks, logo, badges, card border, title, footer, chart, graph, price, UI panels or buttons anywhere. Remove all overlaid interface from the source, including the Everkeep wordmark and demo badge. No financial symbols printed on props. Output one beautiful standalone art image, at least 1200 pixels wide, 4:3 landscape.

Create a sibling illustration to the attached Everkeep frog executive art, preserving the same fictional green frog face, chartreuse glasses, polished cinematic 3D materials and dark orbital office universe. This is an editorial diversification-themed NFT illustration, not a depiction or promise of actual financial holdings. The frog executive is a strategist in a black tailored suit and slim ivory shirt, looking thoughtfully toward the viewer over a desk with an elegant levitating kinetic sculpture of three smooth ivory/brushed-metal spheres orbiting one another. Distant Earth and thin orbital arcs outside a space station panoramic window. Luxurious graphite materials, deep forest green shadows, restrained lime rim highlights and warm ivory. Frog head and glasses dominant, clear silhouette at thumbnail size, central upper half. Distinct pose from original, no cigar. Landscape4:3 full bleed, at least1200px wide. ONLY art. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, logos, card border, interface panels, prices, badges, financial charts, symbols of real tokens, or buttons.

Edit only the supplied illustration. Preserve the frog's face, glasses, green suit, ivory turtleneck, pose, Earth window, steel vault door, lighting, dimensions and composition exactly. Replace ALL gold bars / bullion ingots on the shelves in the upper left with small unmarked clear glass cubes and neutral ceramic sculptural objects. There must be NO gold bars, coins, money, printed marks, numbers or words. This is editorial NFT art for a demoUSD testnet reserve: do not imply ownership of actual gold. Keep the rest unchanged. Standalone art, absolutely no UI or text.
